name: OmaSafe
author: Hung Vo
description: Inspect installed plugins and review GitHub candidates for source drift, capabilities, rule coverage, and scan alerts.

barWidget.description: Scan installed plugins and review uninstalled GitHub candidates without installing them.

schema.label: Enable periodic scans
schema.description: Run OmaSafe automatically while Omarchy Shell is running. Manual scans are always available from the widget.

schema.label: Periodic scan interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to run an automatic scan when periodic scans are enabled.

schema.label: Minimum omasafe-cli version
schema.description: Require omasafe-cli 0.3.0 or newer before running panel commands, including cache hydration, scheduled scans, Source Scan, and host posture.

schema.label: Require OmaSafe CLI identity
schema.description: Require --version output to identify as omasafe-cli.
